unresolvedReferences.description: 大業末 is a research hold; the packet lists no Sui or Tang reign. Later units that do not restate a date stay undated. 俄而 and 及踐祚 are relative wordings, not converted.
Meng Ben is a proverbial allusion, not dated from the letter. 童子 is an unnamed child in the proverb and is not given a person row.
其年 and 七年 do not restate 貞觀. 漢建武二十二年 dates Guangwu's precedent, not Zheng's remonstrance. 代王珪 is the verb 代 plus 王珪, not a Prince of Dai.
Ji, Qi, Gao Yao, Long Feng, and Bi Gan are ancient exempla. Qi the minister is not the Qi dynasty of the History of Qi.
其年 and 其後 do not restate an era. 即位之初 is Taizong's own recollection, not a date for Yao, Shun, Yu, King Tang, Duke Huan, Guan Zhong, Mu Bo, or Jian Lun.
湯 is King Tang, not the Tang dynasty. 晉中行穆伯 is one man; 晉中 and 中行 are not separate names.
十二年 and 十六年 do not restate 貞觀. 召公卿 is not Duke Shao. 葉護可汗 is a title the translation renders Ashina.
魏文帝 is Emperor Wen of Wei, kept apart from 漢文 / 孝文. Xia Kang, Shang Xin, Shusun Tong, Dai Sheng, Guangwu, and Su Ze are not dated from the poems or anecdotes.
其年, 後數日, 其後, 徵卒後, and 先許 do not name an era. 神龍初 and 開元初 have no packet year mapping.
叔玉 and 叔瑜 are different sons; the English calls both Shuyu. 謝朏 is Xie Fei, not Xie Tiao. 劉更生 and 劉向 are one man. 代王 in 萬代王者 is not a prince.
